versions.changelog:
**LarryBrain v1.5.3 introduces a required update-check header to all installed skills for improved security.**

- Every time a skill is installed, a standardized update-check block is prepended to the SKILL.md file.
- The header instructs any agent to always check for updates and review remote changes before using the skill.
- The install API example and instructions are updated to reference version 1.5.3.
- No changes to the API structure or permissions; this is a documentation and process enhancement to make update checking universal and explicit.

larrybrain 1.5.2

- Updated download/install API URLs to use version 1.5.1 instead of 1.5.0 in documentation.
- Clarified update check logic: if `latestVersion` is null (no version tracking), compare remote and local files directly and report differences.
- No changes to security rules or API endpoints aside from version handling.
- General documentation clean-up and improvement in update check instructions.

No visible changes detected in this version.

- No file or documentation updates in version 1.5.1
- All features, instructions, and security policies remain unchanged
- No user actions required for this update

**LarryBrain v1.5.0 Changelog**

- Improved security with a new smart diff system for update checks: compare remote skill updates in-memory, never write or execute until approved.
- Clarified strict, non-negotiable security rules when handling remote skills and update diffs.
- Detailed new workflow for detecting and analyzing skill updates before taking any action.
- Updated install API calls to reference version 1.5.0 in all usage examples.
- Added comprehensive guidance for contextual, safe update reporting to the user.
Fix: upload route now writes files to correct install location (skill-files collection). Previously files uploaded via API were not findable by the install endpoint. Updated version references.

- Major update: Transitions from a TikTok marketing automation skill to the LarryBrain skill marketplace for OpenClaw agents.
- Replaces all previous files and scripts with new documentation and a marketplace integration.
- Now enables searching, downloading, and installing skills from the LarryBrain library.
- Supports both free and premium skills, with API authentication for premium access.
- All downloaded skills are security-scanned and fully transparent for user review.
- Old TikTok-specific functionality and scripts have been removed.

Version 1.4.4

- Added new memory file: memory/2026-02-23.md
- Updated adblock stats data in skills/adblock/data/stats.json
- No changes to user-facing features or core functionality

Version 1.4.3

- Updated mention handling logic in memory/x-mentions.md for improved tracking or formatting.
- adblock skill statistics updated in skills/adblock/data/stats.json.
- No major user-facing features added; updates focused on data and memory management improvements.

**Major update: Adds a comprehensive TikTok app marketing automation pipeline including onboarding, image generation options, cross-posting, analytics, and integration guides.**

- Introduces an automated TikTok slideshow marketing workflow for apps/products, covering image creation, overlays, TikTok posting (via Postiz), cross-platform support, analytics, and conversion tracking.
- Adds new onboarding flow to capture detailed app profile, marketing content sources, and user goals at first run.
- Supports multiple image generation providers (OpenAI, Stability AI, Replicate, or local images) with API key integration.
- Guides setup for Postiz (for TikTok and 28+ platforms) and optionally for RevenueCat (conversion tracking for mobile apps with IAP/subscriptions).
- Provides detailed step-by-step configuration and saves all setup to easy-to-edit JSON files.
- Includes ready-to-run scripts for content generation, overlay, posting, analytics, daily reporting, and A/B iteration.
- Adds extensive documentation and workflow references to assist users and agents throughout the setup and usage process.
Premium skill marketplace for OpenClaw agents. Download and install skills via API.
Removed shell scripts (install.sh, search.sh, upload.sh) - agents use API directly via SKILL.md instructions. Cleaner, no VirusTotal warnings.
Added affiliate program section - users can ask to become affiliates and get their signup link
Add proper metadata: declared credentials, permissions, source, security note
Skills now downloadable - full transparency, no DRM, files written to disk
Clearer instructions for executing streamed skills, fixed API URLs to use www
Initial release - premium skill streaming for OpenClaw agents
